start.speaker: Vera
start.text: You're the detective they sent? Hah. This city eats detectives for breakfast.

n1.speaker: Vera
n1.text: Ask your questions. The rain isn't getting any drier.

choices.text: What do you know about the murder?

murder.speaker: Vera
murder.text: Found him in the alley, cold as the neon. He had a matchbook from the Neon Dragon. That place is nothing but trouble.

discover.title: Lead: The Neon Dragon
discover.desc: Vera says the victim carried a matchbook from the Neon Dragon bar. Worth a visit.

district.speaker: Vera
district.text: The Kanzaki syndicate owns these streets. But you didn't hear it from me. Flash that name around and you'll end up in the alley too.

bye.speaker: Vera
bye.text: Watch your back out there, detective.
